description: Primary USDC prepaid vault for the Callora API marketplace. Handles deposits, per-call deductions, withdrawals, and optional routing of deducted funds to a settlement or revenue-pool contract.

changelog.description: ABI change: withdraw now returns Result<i128, VaultError>, withdraw_to returns Result<i128, VaultError>, and distribute returns Result<(), VaultError>. Failures previously signalled via string panics ('insufficient balance', 'cannot withdraw to vault address') and `unwrap()` on `require_positive_amount` now map to typed VaultError codes. Clients must update to handle the Result return type.

errors.description: Typed error codes returned by vault operations. These replace string panics to enable machine-readable error handling.

codes.name: NotInitialized
codes.description: Vault has not been initialized yet.

codes.name: AlreadyInitialized
codes.description: Vault has already been initialized.

codes.name: Unauthorized
codes.description: Caller is not authorized for this operation.

codes.name: Paused
codes.description: Vault is currently paused.

codes.name: InsufficientBalance
codes.description: Insufficient balance for the requested operation.

codes.name: AmountNotPositive
codes.description: Amount must be positive.

codes.name: ExceedsMaxDeduct
codes.description: Deduct amount exceeds the configured maximum.

codes.name: BelowMinDeposit
codes.description: Deposit amount is below the configured minimum.

codes.name: Overflow
codes.description: Arithmetic overflow detected.

codes.name: InitialBalanceNegative
codes.description: Initial balance must be non-negative.

codes.name: MinDepositNotPositive
codes.description: Min deposit must be positive.

codes.name: MaxDeductNotPositive
codes.description: Max deduct must be positive.

codes.name: MinDepositExceedsMaxDeduct
codes.description: Min deposit cannot exceed max deduct.

codes.name: UsdcTokenCannotBeVault
codes.description: USDC token address cannot be the vault address.

codes.name: RevenuePoolCannotBeVault
codes.description: Revenue pool address cannot be the vault address.

codes.name: AuthorizedCallerCannotBeVault
codes.description: Authorized caller address cannot be the vault address.

codes.name: InitialBalanceExceedsOnLedger
codes.description: Initial balance exceeds on-ledger USDC balance.

codes.name: AlreadyPaused
codes.description: Vault is already paused.

codes.name: NotPaused
codes.description: Vault is not paused.

codes.name: SettlementNotSet
codes.description: Settlement address has not been configured.

codes.name: BatchEmpty
codes.description: Batch deduct requires at least one item.

codes.name: BatchTooLarge
codes.description: Batch size exceeds maximum allowed.

codes.name: NewOwnerSameAsCurrent
codes.description: New owner must be different from current owner.

codes.name: NoOwnershipTransferPending
codes.description: No ownership transfer is pending.

codes.name: NoAdminTransferPending
codes.description: No admin transfer is pending.

codes.name: OfferingIdTooLong
codes.description: Offering ID exceeds maximum length.

codes.name: MetadataTooLong
codes.description: Metadata exceeds maximum length.

codes.name: PriceParseError
codes.description: Price parsing error or non‑positive price.

codes.name: DuplicateRequestId
codes.description: Duplicate request ID detected; this request_id has already been processed.

codes.name: WithdrawToVaultAddress
codes.description: Withdrawal recipient cannot be the vault address. Returned by withdraw_to.

codes.name: Slippage
codes.description: Calculated fee bps (amount * 10_000 / balance) exceeds the caller-supplied max_fee_bps limit.

VaultMeta.description: On-chain vault state returned by init and get_meta.

owner.description: Vault owner; always permitted to deposit and withdraw.

balance.description: Tracked USDC balance in token base units (stroops).

authorized_caller.description: Address permitted to call deduct/batch_deduct. Null means only the owner may deduct.

min_deposit.description: Minimum accepted deposit amount. Defaults to 1.

DeductItem.description: Single entry in a batch_deduct call.

amount.description: Amount to deduct in token base units; must be > 0.

request_id.description: Optional tracking identifier. When provided it is enforced as a single-use idompotency key.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Initialize the vault. Can only be called once. Owner must sign the transaction.

params.name: owner
params.description: Vault owner address; must authorize.

params.name: usdc_token
params.description: USDC token contract address (must not equal the vault address).

params.name: initial_balance
params.description: Pre-seeded tracked balance. USDC must already be held by the vault. Defaults to 0.

params.name: authorized_caller
params.description: Address allowed to trigger deductions. Defaults to none (owner only).

params.name: min_deposit
params.description: Minimum per-deposit amount. Defaults to 1.

params.name: revenue_pool
params.description: Optional informational revenue-pool contract address. Must not equal vault address.

params.name: max_deduct
params.description: Maximum amount per single deduct call. Defaults to i128::MAX (no cap). Must be positive and >= min_deposit.

panics: "vault already initialized" — called more than once.
"usdc_token cannot be vault address" — self-reference guard.
"revenue_pool cannot be vault address" — self-reference guard.

functions.name: deposit
functions.description: Transfer USDC from depositor into vault and increase tracked balance. Blocked when paused.

params.name: depositor
params.description: Must be owner or an allowed depositor; must authorize.

params.name: amount
params.description: Amount to deposit; must be > 0 and >= min_deposit.

panics: "vault is paused" — circuit breaker is active.
"unauthorized: only owner or allowed depositor can deposit" — auth failure.
"deposit below minimum: X < Y" — below min_deposit.

functions.name: withdraw
functions.description: Withdraw USDC from the vault to the owner. Blocked when paused. Returns the new tracked balance or a typed VaultError.

params.name: amount
params.description: Amount to withdraw in token base units; must be > 0 and <= balance.

functions.name: withdraw_to
functions.description: Withdraw USDC from the vault to an arbitrary recipient address. Blocked when paused. Returns the new tracked balance or a typed VaultError.

params.name: recipient
params.description: Destination address; must not equal the vault address.

params.name: amount
params.description: Amount to withdraw in token base units; must be > 0 and <= balance.

functions.name: distribute
functions.description: Route deducted funds to the configured settlement address. Blocked when paused. Returns unit on success or a typed VaultError.

params.name: amount
params.description: Amount to distribute in token base units; must be > 0 and <= balance.

errors.name: SettlementNotSet
errors.condition: Settlement address has not been configured.

functions.name: set_price
functions.description: Store off‑chain price for an offering. Owner‑only. Offering ID limited to 64 characters. Price must be a positive integer string.

params.name: caller
params.description: Vault owner; must authorize.

params.name: offering_id
params.description: Offering identifier; max 64 characters.

params.name: price
params.description: Price value as string; must parse to a positive i128.

panics: "unauthorized: owner only" — caller is not the owner.
"price parse error" — price cannot be parsed to a positive integer.

functions.name: get_price
functions.description: Retrieve stored price for an offering. Returns null if not set.

params.name: offering_id
params.description: Offering identifier to look up.

functions.name: set_metadata
functions.description: Store off-chain metadata (e.g. IPFS cID) for an offering. Owner-only. offering_id max 64 chars; metadata max 256 chars.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the vault owner; must authorize.

params.name: offering_id
params.description: Offering identifier; max 64 characters.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Metadata value (e.g. IPFS CID or URI). Max 256 characters.
